note: Grant Parish has no public zoning district polygon service found. The Parish Police Jury site (gppj.org) lists district maps and ordinances but no zoning layer or zoning ordinance. The largest town, Colfax, publishes its zoning map only as a PDF (Jan 2024). Pollock posts its zoning ordinances as downloadable files, with no GIS layer. No ArcGIS Hub or Online zoning layer for the parish or its towns was found. Parcel data exists only from commercial vendors (Regrid, DynamoSpatial), which are not official zoning.
